QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Swingboat Disaster
QuestInfo.2: You defeated #r#o8145008##k #bx100#k but, unfortunately, it was a wasted effort.

0.msg: We're in a tight spot here. The Swingboat is being repaired, but it's taking too long. It should have been finished by now.

1.msg: What!? No! Why isn't it repaired yet? My plan! My glorious plan!

2.msg: The monsters took the tools we need, so repairs are at a complete standstill right now. Although, we'd have it done in no time if you could retrieve the #btool bag#k...

3.msg: #h0#, I've only got one shot at this. #bDelilah's#k heart rate has already dropped again. Aren't you going to help find the #btool bag#k?

yes.0: Oh, how kind of you! I'll bet one of those #r#o8145008##k monsters took the bag, because the wrench looks like a bone. You'll find it once you defeat #r#o8145008##k #bx100#k.

no.0: Shouldn't we just push the repair to tomorrow if we don't have the tools?

yes.0: You didn't get anything from Bearic the White? Hm...

default.0: You'll find it once you defeat #r#o8145008##k #bx100#k.
